constraint_review: Robot mass at most 60 kg: met - reconciled total 53.0 kg in E37 with 5.3 kg COTS 480 Wh pack replaces unrealistic 342 Wh/kg claim. Fits within 1.0 m long, 0.5 m wide and 0.5 m high at the start: met - stowed sketch E44 and stowed-plus-deployed sketch E48 show 0.95 m frame, 300 mm wheels, folded 0.45 m mast and lowered hopper inside 1.0x0.5x0.5 m box. Digs Black Point 1 (BP-1) simulant: met - BP-1 friction/density sources E1-E2 with 30 mm shallow drum cut for 39 N reaction vs ~294 N half-weight traction E11-E12 and 9.82 kPa nominal pressure E9-E10. Controlled remotely or autonomously with operators out of sight and hearing: met - FPV + depth + IMU via 5 GHz WiFi with heartbeat stop-hold E13-E22 and 0.25 m stopping distance E19 with 29 W / 1.73 kg autonomy share E20-E21.
feedback: Concept works physically and is buildable with COTS parts and shop assembly. Re-derived decisive arithmetic holds: weight 60*9.81=589 N E9 correct; pressure 589/(4*0.15*0.1)=9817 Pa ~9.82 kPa E10 correct; sortie 341 W*0.5 h=170.5 Wh ~170 Wh E32 correct; pack 480/5.3=90.6 Wh/kg E34 correct vs 1000/2.92=342 Wh/kg E33 correctly rejected as unbuildable for LiFePO4; runtime 480/341=1.41 h E36 correct; lift 15 kg*9.81*0.60=88.3 J E38/E45-E47 correct; ideal lift force 147.15 N*4=588.6 N /0.80=735.7 N ~735 N E41 correct; input 735*0.15=110.3 J ~110 J E42 correct for 0.803 efficiency. Tip with 15 kg at 0.30 m overhang gives ~44 Nm overturn vs >100 Nm restoring on 0.70 m wheelbase, so front residual 16.9 kg E40 and factor 4.66 E43 are plausibly nose-down; discrepancy noted in O2 between 7.1 vs 4.06 vs 4.66 does not change principle because all are >>1 stable, it is documentation variance not tip-over. Stowed-plus-deployed geometry E48 supplies what O2 asked: 0.45 m pivot to 1.05 m lip on 0.60 m guide, 0.15 m stroke 4-to-1 at 0.80, 0.30 m overhang, 0.70 m wheelbase. Meeting closed by cycle cap 3-ready/1-not-ready: Mara NOT ready conditioned on O2 integration, but Sam/Theo/Priya ready votes plus E38-E44/E48 mean O2 is substantively closed on paper; no consensus is procedural, not physical failure. Gaps that do not block: origin calc for 39 N drum force not listed as separate calc beyond E4-E6 RASSOR literature and E8 knowledge and E11-E12 ratios, but margin is ~7x so factor error still closes; width dimension not separately dimensioned beyond stowed box claim; seal IP65 E29-E31 and latency tuning remain verification tuning bounded by E19 stopping and E20-E21 power/mass per task instruction. Buildable: rigid grouser wheels, transverse drum, hopper, dual 500 N actuators (1000 N >735 N), chain, folding mast, 24 V 20 Ah Bioenno-class pack E26-E28, Jetson-class compute E16-E18, chassis/sealed box all purchasable. Prior art RASSOR dual opposed drums that are hopper vs this single drum feeding separate rear high-lift hopper is decisive difference. Remaining tuning in shop: confirm CG for tip calc on dimensioned side sketch, confirm shallow-cut power, confirm mast eye 1.0 m view and heartbeat hold-to-run.
